reviews_captured_by_me.text: Bernadette was wonderful to work with through our kitchen remodel. She came out and measured everything for us and was very patient with my multiple questions and design changes. We had zero problems with installation and I would work with Bernadette again if I had another kitchen remodel.

Bernadette was awesome to work with.  When I first went in we lined out what I wanted at the middle price line.  But it was more than I had in my budget.  She worked with me to creatively combine two price lines (which are the same quality and construction - just less selection) which resulted in BIG savings and it came together stunningly.  It is just like I envisioned.  She was undaunted by several rounds of my indecision, I even changed the finishes midway through.  Definitely would work with Bernadette again.

We had an excellent experience with Bernadette (who designed our kitchen) and Northern Countertops (who went above and beyond to hand-craft a super awesome huge 100% butcher-block wood countertop.)  Highly recommend.
